verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs say it offers a full REST API for interacting with the application, plus a separate public read-only SDK Connection Endpoint. The official MCP server is built on authenticated calls to that same REST API, which corroborates that it can be driven programmatically. missing for 10: detail on endpoint coverage and authentication in the evidence, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
